notes_for_editor: Status conflict to check by a human before publishing: the 2014 Division of Forestry extant list and the Tennessee Landforms list both say standing, while a photo caption on the telliquah.com Starr Mountain page calls the fire tower abandoned. That caption is undated and is the only abandonment source. Elevation is 2,205 ft on Landforms and 2,200 ft in the mountain-bike guide. The Forest Service Starr Mountain land purchase page (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/projects/archive/61680) describes about 153 acres on Starr Mountain next to Gee Creek Wilderness; it does not mention the tower, so the tower site's owner is unknown. Agency is inferred from membership in the Division of Forestry list, not stated for this tower. The cached NHLR Tennessee register list has no Starr Mountain entry. No build date, builder, height or current access rules found.
